recap.text: Donut has a red dagger after her name for a magic missile fired while they were running away. Carl opens his Hunter-Killer boxes in a floating row to the wall, from Xindy's mangled claw and 1,000 gold to 595,000 gold in all, and owes the Emberus fountain 29,750. Donut's own box gives her a gray hand and only 1,000 gold, to her outrage. Fourteen more Hunter Killer boxes leave him 52 hunting trophies.

beats.headline: A red dagger, then thirty-four
beats.text: Donut has a new symbol after her name, a single red dagger with its point up, like the Desperado Club's logo: Hunter Killer X 1, for a magic missile fired while they were running away. Carl dives into his notifications. The Hand that Claws the Master (x35): he has permanently killed a non-crawler biological, and the AI admits it may have slipped an extra one in. The reward is a Gold Hunter-Killer Box (x34), with a note that the achievement may be awarded more than once, but the boxes only on the sixth floor. He has killed thirty-four.
beats.gist: Donut earns a Hunter Killer mark for a magic missile, and Carl is awarded thirty-four Gold Boxes.

beats.headline: A row down to the wall
beats.text: Donut has a Hunter-Killer box of her own but wants Carl to open his first, because thirty-four will be more dramatic. They line up in a row floating all the way to the wall, and everybody stops to watch. The first holds 1,000 gold and the mangled claw of Xindy, the mantis he blew out of the sky; the second, 2,000 and the hand of Chin'dua; the third, 3,000 and an orc's hand. Each adds a thousand, 595,000 gold in all, and the Emberus fountain chimes: Carl owes it 29,750. Donut's own box gives her a gray hand and, to her outrage, only 1,000 gold.
beats.gist: Carl opens his Hunter-Killer box first, and each box adds a thousand gold; Donut's holds only 1,000.

beats.headline: Fourteen more than expected
beats.text: Most of Carl's new prize boxes are low-tier adventurer boxes, but fourteen are Hunter Killer boxes, including the one from Future Hunter the orc, several more than he expected. He seems to have been credited for three nebs and three mantises killed by another mantis while she was enraged, though not for her own death at the hands of her people. Those six earn boxes and no experience. He now has 52 hunting trophies and 637,000 gold from those boxes alone.
beats.gist: Carl receives fourteen Hunter Killer boxes, including six for kills by others that earn no experience.

relations.note: his fountain takes its share of the gold
